_doc: GPIO map for keybordy MP on an ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8. `just mp-gen` writes firmware/macropad/main/board_pins.h from it; `just mp-lint` checks it.
Off-limits on this module: 19/20 (native USB), 26-32 (flash), 33/34 (not bonded out), 35-37 (octal PSRAM).
Strapping pins (0, 3, 45, 46) are allowed only with a `strap` note saying why the boot level stays right.
43/44 are UART0. Logs go over USB-Serial-JTAG, so they are free, but the ROM prints on 43 at boot.

amp_sd.strap: MAX98357A SD_MODE has an internal 100k pull-down, so GPIO46 reads low at boot (boot-mode strap wants low)

dc.note: ROM boot chatter on U0TXD only toggles DC while CS is high, so the panel ignores it

mic_led.strap: LED + resistor to GND holds GPIO45 low at boot (VDD_SPI strap wants low for 3.3 V flash)
